'''''Luminous Star''''' was a [[Seltiss-1 caravel]] that was built by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] and used by the company [[Skydove Freight]] to carry goods between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> In about [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> ''Luminous Star'' became damaged during an encounter with some [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], which rendered the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] weapons systems inoperable, and the vessel was subsequently berthed in a Skydove Freight warehouse on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
